headline: Callahan Front Ignites as Island Clashes Ease and Expanse Bloodshed Mounts
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, the center of gravity has shifted sharply toward Callahan’s Passage, where a heavy surge of twelve base transitions in the past two hours rocked positions around The Latch and The Crumbling Passage amid mounting casualties. Meanwhile, the ferocious island struggle in Fisherman’s Row has noticeably cooled, tapering to two recent strategic events following its earlier tempest of captures. Bloodshed remains staggering across Weathered Expanse, where over five thousand casualties were tallied in two hours alone alongside renewed contest over Frostmarch, Wightwalk, and Crow’s Nest. Along the eastern front, Stlican Shelf saw tactical shifts abate slightly to a single recent transfer at Breaker Town, while Nevish Line and Mooring County sustain intense, grinding casualty exchanges without immediate boundary movement. Linn of Mercy and Marban Hollow have settled into quieter lulls after earlier skirmishes, leaving Callahan’s Passage and the blood-soaked expanse of the north-central snowfields as the war’s primary powder kegs.
